# range_body — articulation audit and repair

Status: FAIL / not physically certified. Geometry and export repairs are complete; the strict source-alignment and physical-hardware evidence checks remain open. See [artcheck_report.json](../artcheck_report.json) and [review triptychs](../review/artcheck_range_body.jpg).

The former fitted tilt was 5.1093 degrees. The repaired visible frame is upright to 0.000000 degrees, with a common appliance yaw of -3.06730 degrees. The door, drawer and both rack instances use the same level axes; yaw is applied once at the instance. Original joint names, materials and texture files are retained.

The noisy sloping hinge and leaning door were replaced by a horizontal bottom-edge hinge. The front surround and gasket now meet the upright door; the backguard was refitted under the same yaw. Handle mounts clear the fixed frame. The stop is 90 degrees, consistent with the dense video sequence. The modeled pivot is 4 mm in front of the lower metal edge; the real hinge hardware is hidden.

Final front-plane visual mesh sampling: 1996 perimeter points, maximum gap 2.930 mm; metal face coplanarity 0.000 mm. Rounded portions with no surface at the front section are outside this planar test; it is not a volumetric seal test.

Ten-step MuJoCo sweeps: PASS, maximum penetration 0.000000 mm. Parent/child collision filtering is disabled; collision masks remain enabled. The combined door/drawer endpoint sweep also has no penetration. Fixed welded components within one body are not treated as independent colliding bodies.

Source alignment: FAIL, maximum checked edge residual 28.56 pixels at 1280 x 1707. Camera matrices and intrinsics are unchanged. The source door-side traces disagree with the supplied projected gravity direction by 3.35–5.57 degrees on the long checked edges; geometry cannot simultaneously be upright and absorb this residual. Source traces have approximately 6-pixel uncertainty. Fits and scores share frames and are not independent held-out validation.

Observed-state reprojection: FAIL, 3 frames, worst residual 40.45 pixels. Current q values are {'f3446': 0.34787545331144654, 'f3459': 0.5397729777699798, 'f3483': 1.5707963267948963}. Both supplied articulation and splat q values are retained in the report; their inconsistent open states are not accepted as unquestioned ground truth.

Export verification: PASS. GLB versus OBJ vertex error 8.64e-13 m; MJCF versus declared joint motion over ten states 4.61e-08 m. Both MJCF and URDF load and retain joint names, axes and ranges. Each convex contact piece is watertight and has positive volume. Mass/friction/damping/actuator estimates are retained; component inertia follows the repaired geometry and remains estimated. MuJoCo uses flat proxy appearance; GLB retains textures. Cloth remains a rigid carried fallback and is not certified textile dynamics.

Viewer: front [0, 1, 0] in the Z-up asset frame; preferred view azimuth 90 degrees, elevation 18 degrees. glTF coordinate conversion is (x,y,z) → (x,z,-y).

Rebuild the full audited set with `nice -n 19 taskset -c 16-19 .venv-sim/bin/python scenes/kitchen_1/gpt6/assets/range_oven/build_all.py` from `[source workspace]`. The asset `build.py` scripts call the shared `asset_builder.py`; persistent upright constraints are in `artcheck_geometry.py`. The full driver regenerates model files, assembly, physics checks, calibrated renders, reports and notes. All work is CPU only.

Unresolved requirements: camera/source registration within 10 px and real hardware axis within 2 degrees / 5 mm; unactuated slide limits and states additionally require new observation. No completion marker was issued.
